job.title: Automation Developer
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Automation Developer with hands-on NiCE RPA expertise to join a major digital transformation programme within the UK Public Sector.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on enterprise-scale automation solutions, helping to streamline business processes, improve operational efficiency and support the delivery of critical public services. The successful candidate will work closely with technical teams, architects and business stakeholders to design, develop, deploy and enhance robust automation solutions.

Please note: Due to urgent onboarding requirements, applicants must already hold active SC Clearance. Candidates without current clearance cannot be considered.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test and deploy automation solutions using NiCE RPA.
  • Maintain, optimise and enhance existing automation workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, defects and technical challenges.
  • Translate business requirements into effective technical automation solutions.
  • Support releases, deployments and go-live activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation, ensuring adherence to development standards.
  • Collaborate with engineering, architecture and platform teams to deliver secure, scalable automation solutions.
  • Ensure solutions comply with security, governance and technical best practices.


Essential Skills & Experience:

  • Hands-on NiCE RPA development experience – mandatory.
  • Active SC Clearance – mandatory and must be held at the point of application.
  • Minimum 3 years' experience delivering RPA or automation solutions.
  • Previous experience within Central Government or the wider Public Sector.
  • Proven experience developing, deploying and supporting enterprise-scale automations.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
  • Experience integrating automation solutions with wider enterprise systems.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

job.title: Service Designer
job.description:
An experienced Service Designer is required to join a major UK Central Government transformation programme, working on complex services used by citizens and operational teams.

The assignment will focus on understanding how services operate end-to-end and identifying opportunities to simplify journeys, address pain points and improve the experience across digital and non-digital channels.

You’ll be joining an established multidisciplinary environment and working across the wider service landscape rather than focusing solely on individual products or touchpoints. Experience designing services involving vulnerable or hard-to-reach users would be particularly valuable.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Mapping current and future-state services across multiple channels and touchpoints
  • Developing service blueprints, journey maps and other service design artefacts
  • Bringing together user, operational, policy and business perspectives to identify opportunities for improvement
  • Facilitating workshops to explore problems, test assumptions and develop potential service solutions
  • Working alongside User Researchers to turn research evidence into service improvements
  • Collaborating with Product, Delivery, Business Analysis and Architecture colleagues
  • Helping teams understand dependencies, pain points and gaps across end-to-end journeys
  • Presenting service concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Contributing throughout discovery, alpha, beta and live phases
  • Supporting teams in applying GDS and UCD principles in practice


What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive experience producing and evolving service blueprints
  • Strong journey mapping and end-to-end service mapping capability
  • The ability to make complex services understandable through clear visualisation
  • Experience facilitating workshops involving diverse and senior stakeholder groups
  • Confidence navigating complex operational and organisational environments
  • Experience working as part of multidisciplinary agile teams
  • An evidence-led approach to service design and decision-making
  • Strong communication and stakeholder influencing skills
  • Knowledge of GDS standards, UCD practices and government service assessments would be advantageous, as would experience working on large-scale citizen-facing or operational services.

job.title: User Researcher
job.description:
We are hiring an experienced User Researcher to support a major digital transformation programme within UK Central Government.

This is an excellent opportunity to work on high-profile, complex public services that have a significant impact on citizens, businesses and frontline operations. Previous experience conducting research with vulnerable or hard-to-reach user groups would be particularly beneficial.

The role is primarily remote, with occasional attendance required for collaborative UCD workshops, typically up to one day per month onsite. The initial contract is for 6 months, with extensions highly likely.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, design and conduct user research throughout the delivery lifecycle
  • Select and apply appropriate qualitative and quantitative research methods
  • Analyse and synthesise research findings into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Communicate complex user needs effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Influence product and service decisions through evidence-based insights
  • Facilitate workshops, stakeholder sessions and research playbacks
  • Work within a multidisciplinary agile team to embed user-centred design principles
  • Ensure research activities align with government standards and recognised best practice
  • Support inclusive research approaches across a diverse range of users


Essential Experience

  • Proven experience as a User Researcher within UK Central Government
  • Strong experience delivering research across complex digital transformation programmes
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary agile delivery teams
  • Ability to translate research findings into practical recommendations and service improvements
  • Strong workshop and facilitation skills
  • Experience managing multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities
  • Confidence presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Active SC Clearance


Desirable Experience

  • Experience working within a major UK government department or similarly complex public-sector environment
  • Familiarity with GDS Service Standards and the wider Government Digital Service ecosystem
  • Experience within large-scale transformation or operational service environments
  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive research practices
  • Experience conducting research with vulnerable, sensitive or hard-to-reach user groups
